question: An Uber cab covers a distance of 640 km in 80 hours. What is its speed in km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed can be directly calculated by finding the ratio of total distance to total time.

Speed = 640 ÷ 80 = 8 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance covered by the cab (D) = 640 km

Time taken (T) = 80 hours

 
• 
 Distance = 640 km Start End CAB 
 Speed = ? km/hr Time = 80 hours 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 640 ÷ 80

⇒ Speed = 8 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert Speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by (5 ÷ 18). Conversely, to convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by (18 ÷ 5).

Average Speed

When a journey is covered in multiple segments with different speeds, Average Speed = Total Distance Covered ÷ Total Time Taken.

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their speeds (S₁ − S₂). If they move in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).
